t: Easily adjustable, rechargeable head torch that delivers a convenient hand-free lighting solution with spot and floodlight options. Features Turbo, High, Medium, Low, COB High, COB Low and COB Red light modes, with run times of 30 seconds, 1 hour, 2 hours, 3 hours, 25 minutes, 1 hour and 35 minutes respectively. Positioning of the beam is controlled by an integrated tilt feature. Water and impact-resistant. Includes a one size fits all head strap. Supplied with a USB-C to USB charging cable.
